sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A miniature epiphytic orchid of humid evergreen forests in northern Madagascar, reported at about 500–1,000 m. It typically bears five or six leaves and an inflorescence with one to three flowers. A flower can be about 4.5 cm long, notably because of its long tubular lip. The available evidence corrects older references to New Guinea; the sources consulted do not document food use.
